messages:
Rebecca (Recruiter): Hey team — quick heads up: Emily (candidate) signed her offer for L4 yesterday but just emailed saying she needs to start 3 weeks earlier due to a lease overlap. We already approved a $10k sign-on to match market.
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Thanks. We need her onboarding in the office earlier than expected. I can cover ramp tasks. Is there any blocking on comp/approvals to move start date up? @Linda please advise on payroll timing.
Linda (People Ops): If start moves earlier, payroll cycle could miss the first sign-on tranche. Two options: 1) frontload 50% on first payroll (requires comp exception approval), 2) split as-is but issue a one-time relocation/accommodation stipend manually. Which do you prefer?
Rebecca (Recruiter): Manager prefers option 1 — frontload 50% to help with moving costs. Candidate is requesting start date of 2026-04-15 instead of 2026-05-06.
PeopleOps-Bot: Approval request created: REQ-2026-0421 — "Frontload 50% of sign-on for early start". Routing to: Comp Committee -> Payroll -> Legal. ETA for standard routing: 3 business days. Link: https://internal.redwood/req/REQ-2026-0421
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Can we expedite? Onboarding depends on this timing. Emily would otherwise defer and take another offer.
Maya (Comp): I'll review the band rationale. Quick note: band L4 midpoint is $X, candidate was matched; frontloading sign-on doesn't change base. Need justification in request (retention/relocation risk).
Sanjay (Legal): No contractual issues with frontloading, but need updated offer amendment signed and KBA confirmation if payment before 30 days. I can draft a one-line amendment if comp approves.
Payroll Bot: Payroll note: to process a partial sign-on on first payroll we need PR number and amendment by noon Wed to hit 04/15 pay run. Otherwise next run is 05/01.
Linda (People Ops): TL;DR: if comp committee signs off by EOD Tuesday and legal signs amendment, payroll can push 50% on 04/15. Otherwise use relocation stipend on first possible run. I can escalate to comp chair for fast-track.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Emily confirmed she can sign an amendment today. She prefers frontload. I'm pinging candidate now.
Emily (Candidate): I can sign the amendment today — appreciate the help! :pray:
PeopleOps-Bot: REQ-2026-0421 status update: Escalated to Comp Chair (Maya). Requested decision by 2026-04-07 17:00 PT. Notifications set.
Maya (Comp): Approved for frontload 50% under "early-onboarding accommodation". Please attach manager justification + candidate acknowledgement.
Sanjay (Legal): Draft amendment posted: https://internal.redwood/agreements/AMEND-452 — includes payment schedule and clawback if termination within 90 days. Rebecca please get signed copy.
Payroll Bot: Received PR#452-FO. Payroll will schedule $5,000 on 04/15 and remainder on 07/01. Moving to final processing.
Linda (People Ops): Great — marking thread resolved. Rebecca, please confirm amendment signed and update the offer folder.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Amendment signed (attached). Emily will start 2026-04-15. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Huge thanks. Onboarding plan updated.
PeopleOps-Bot: Thread closed: REQ-2026-0421 — Completed.
